-- 1. Clear duplicate candidate2 slots in 6 uncontested House races
UPDATE house_races SET candidate2_name = NULL, candidate2_party = NULL
WHERE (state_code = 'AL' AND district = 5 AND candidate2_name = 'Dale W. Strong')
   OR (state_code = 'IN' AND district = 3 AND candidate2_name = 'Marlin Stutzman')
   OR (state_code = 'IN' AND district = 4 AND candidate2_name = 'Jim Baird')
   OR (state_code = 'KY' AND district = 2 AND candidate2_name = 'Brett Guthrie')
   OR (state_code = 'PA' AND district = 7 AND candidate2_name = 'Ryan Mackenzie')
   OR (state_code = 'PA' AND district = 10 AND candidate2_name = 'Scott Perry');

-- 2. Promote OH Governor to General (Acton D vs. Ramaswamy R — both confirmed)
UPDATE governor_races
SET status = 'General',
    dem_candidate = 'Amy Acton',
    rep_candidate = 'Vivek Ramaswamy',
    notes = 'Open seat — Mike DeWine term-limited. D: Amy Acton (former OH Health Director). R: Vivek Ramaswamy (former presidential candidate). General election November 3, 2026.'
WHERE state_code = 'OH';

-- 3. Promote OR Governor to General (Kotek D vs. Drazan R — both confirmed)
UPDATE governor_races
SET status = 'General',
    dem_candidate = 'Tina Kotek',
    rep_candidate = 'Christine Drazan',
    notes = 'Incumbent Tina Kotek (D) seeking re-election vs. Christine Drazan (R, 2022 nominee). Rated Solid D.'
WHERE state_code = 'OR';

-- 4. Fix NE Governor: Jim Pillen wins R primary (running for re-election, NOT term-limited)
UPDATE governor_races
SET status = 'General',
    rep_candidate = 'Jim Pillen',
    notes = 'Incumbent Jim Pillen (R) running for re-election vs. Lynne Walz (D). Rated Likely R.'
WHERE state_code = 'NE';
